root: ^You trudged through the door and caught your noisy neighbour just in time before he could do harm to his wife.
^The valor and bravery you demonstrated that night is something we rarely see. For that, we commend you.
^Unfortunately, you managed to lose your lottery ticket in the ensuing scuffle. The friendly Old Lady Next Door found it and cashed it in.
^We hear she recently bought a house in the Hamptons.
^Needless to say, your landlord was less happy to learn that you couldn't pay your rent on time.
^But after hearing about your heroism, he decided to extend your deadline by another day.
^Sometimes, you feel tiny pinpricks on your skin, a reminder of how it felt to hold that beautiful lottery ticket that carried your lucky numbers.
^Alas, we had higher hopes for you, Stephen.
